title: Final: the Framework era
cards/0/task: Walk through the key Framework years: 2002, 2005, 2007, 2012 and 2019.
cards/2/q: Which 90s problem did .NET solve with versioned assemblies?
cards/2/explain: An assembly knows its version, and an app asks for the one it needs.
cards/3/q: Why will Framework 4.8 get no new APIs?
cards/3/options/0: It is shared by all of Windows and updated in place, so changing it is risky, and development moved to the new .NET
cards/4/q: Where is Framework 4.8 still needed today? Select all that apply.
cards/4/explain: Revit 2025 is already on .NET 8, and Framework does not run on Linux.
cards/5/q: Match each year to what it brought
cards/6/q: A plugin runs on the runtime of...
cards/6/options/1: whatever was installed last on the system
cards/6/explain: A plugin lives in the host's process, so it lives in the host's runtime too.
cards/7/explain: AutoCAD 2024, like Revit 2024, runs on Framework 4.8.
